name: Magpie AI Agent Router
description: Magpie CLI/HTTP adapter providing intelligent multi-provider model routing (llm.router.v1), domain AI assistant (ai.agent.v1), streaming/structured chat completions (llm.chat.v1), and context/glossary translation (llm.translate.v1).
author: OmniDesk Contributors

config_schema.label: Magpie CLI Path
config_schema.description: Executable name or absolute path to the magpie CLI binary.

config_schema.label: Gateway URL Override
config_schema.description: Optional Magpie HTTP gateway base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3425). Leave empty for automatic discovery via ~/.config/magpie/gateway.json.

config_schema.label: Dedicated Route Group ID
config_schema.description: Magpie routing group exclusively managed by OmniDesk without modifying terminal agent configs.

config_schema.label: Default Routing Strategy
config_schema.description: Default Magpie group routing strategy applied when updating the OmniDesk route group.

config_schema.label: Session Sticky Policy
config_schema.description: Account/key stickiness policy for the OmniDesk route group.

config_schema.label: Inference Timeout (ms)
config_schema.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for Magpie /v1/chat/completions calls.

config_schema.label: Gateway API Key
config_schema.description: Optional Bearer token for Magpie HTTP gateway (stored in SecretVault).
